Alt text only writes the alt text of an inline data image

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{inline_data_media: "AltTextOnly"}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Before <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" alt=\"icon\"> after</p>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
